records.interpretation: Footnote attributes sponsorship mainly to VinFast; group-profit attribution ratio cannot prove the common-parent share of this subsidiary income.

Restriction is subsidiary income retained under reinvestment commitment, not an employee welfare expense. Economic claim and issuer EPS/distributability numerator remain separate.

Parent-attributable consolidated NPAT is not the standalone parent NPAT.
Footnote says mainly chairman non-refundable grants to VinFast; mainly is not an exact recipient decomposition.
Related-party transaction amount is not automatically the same population/recognition basis as sponsor P&L income. 54157m difference is a diagnostic, not matched residual.
Aggregate gains include Novatech; do not deduct both aggregate and its components. Retained property/other disposal gains are not automatically sustainable.

August demerger from VinFast JSC precedes September disposal. License fully settled by offsetting and cash; related R&D assets remain at carrying value, difference in other payables. License fee is not proved a full current P&L expense.
Do not classify all disposals alike: technology sale distinct from property project rotation. Amounts are whole-billion presentations.
Neither the aggregate unrecognized loss-tax effect nor aggregate disposal reconciliation proves Novatech or grant transaction tax.
Restricted Vinschool income is retained/reinvestment restricted, not welfare leakage. Keep economic common profit and distributable numerator separate; deduct exactly once.
Printed year-end percentages are observations, not transaction-date profit allocation. VinFast JSC has 99.90 voting versus 50.60 economic interest.
Opening and closing interest differ. Endpoint observations do not establish exact event-date attribution or an interval valid throughout the year.
Do not replace group parent-attributable NPAT by this standalone NPAT or add it on top of group profit.
Dividends mainly from subsidiaries and intercompany interest are consolidation controls, not extra group earnings.
Direct capital holding is not the consolidated effective profit interest or a per-event common allocation.

Multiple preference series, no voting, stated coupon/return rates and optional conversions; new series issued in March/December 2025. Rate and conversion rights cannot be collapsed to a single share ratio.
Dividends require positive cumulative post-tax profit after paying all preference dividends and no breach of payment obligations; no automatic assumption of current cash dividend or conversion.
Transfer retained profit to owner reserve is equity-neutral, not an employee fund expense. FY2025 movement is distinct from 2026 plan even if amount matches.
5bn to reserve and all remaining accumulated profit retained for business. Plan contains no non-owner allocation; this does not prove all subsidiaries have no employee funds.
Separate current and comparative columns. 5bn reserve move in 2026 is compatible with plan but not uniquely event-ID matched; no P&L deduction.
August Novatech demerger and planned sale to chairman; explicitly says some VinFast preference-share conversion ratios will change following transaction. Not a June-30 executed disposal.
Comparative is H1_2025, not FY2025. 2026 receiver names/perimeter do not retrospectively split the FY2025 annual sponsor income.
Approves accumulated-profit use under the attached BOD submission. Not authority for portfolio posting/scoring.

The demerger occurred 2025-08-22. Some VinFast preference shares were exchanged into Novatech preference shares and transfer arrangements signed. The displayed investment is an asset, not additional FY2025 earnings or accepted market value.

FY2025 transaction amounts, not closing balance. Debt offset plus cash equals contract amount. Do not treat entire fee as cash outflow, full current P&L expense or infer all ending other payables are zero.

FY2025 source policy: VinFast eligible manufacturing 10% for first 15 years from revenue, first four years exempt subject to specified start rule, next nine years 50% tax reduction. Eligibility, start year and application to grant/Novatech gain are not established. Foreign subsidiaries follow local rules; do not assume 20% or a current holiday for each event.
Closing/opening balance-sheet tax positions and current-year P&L column kept separate. These totals do not identify grant or Novatech transaction tax.

Loss pools reported without DTA recognition due to uncertain future taxable income. No allocation to VinFast JSC, no cross-entity netting, no automatic tax credit on normalization. Source also reports FY2025 transitional relief/no supplementary global-minimum-tax expense; this is not a general future tax conclusion.
Standalone tax reconciliation, current-year column. Do not attribute this tax or effective rate to consolidated Novatech/VinFast events.
Visually checked column binding: 162656 is opening balance, 310681 is current P&L income. Unreviewed OCR order must not reverse these columns. This is parent scope, not VinFast standalone tax.
Same physical page, distinct unit from DTA table. Parent losses have no recognized DTA; do not add this pool to consolidated losses or assign it to VinFast.
Source states FY2025 transitional safe-harbour relief and no supplementary global-minimum-tax expense. This does not prove zero transaction current/deferred tax on grants or share disposal.
Published outstanding includes subsidiary-held shares accounted as treasury at group level; subtract for external common denominator. Not a current-price anchor.
Historical reported EPS only, not accepted normalized EPS; shares are weighted averages, not closing counts.
Excluded now does not mean no future dilution. Reassess dilution when normalized numerator differs; no backdated 2026 conversion.
No addition of JSC loss to already consolidated segment loss; segment values are not owner cash flow or RNAV.
Capex totals do not identify maintenance/expansion split. Segment sum plus central income must match group PBT.
Two reported years are counterevidence, not a full-cycle normalized forecast.
Different period and claims: do not annualize, backdate deductions to FY2025 or assume preferred claims stay zero.
Notes refer to subsidiary Class A preference and repurchase; do not assign these deductions to VinFast without explicit binding.
Book values, not fair value. Existing impairment/provision is already embedded in net assets.
Debt classes disjoint on balance sheet; include exchange bonds separately once. Provisions are within total liabilities.
Book NCI and preferred par are not their fair/economic claims; treasury book already deducted, not deducted twice.

Maintenance funds held for building boards overlap unknown with restrictions; free cash not fully qualified. Equal cost/fair values explicitly reported for held preference investment, not amount-only mapping.
Short/long term deposits separate from cash equivalents. Rounded pledged amounts; do not assert exact upper bound or double subtract maintenance funds.
Inventory NRV/provisions are not project RNAV. Collateral not another debt haircut after full debt subtraction.
Issuer explicitly has insufficient information to determine investment-property fair values.
Only projects over 10% listed. Historical cost/investment spend not projected remaining cost. Capitalization rate is not a qualified project WACC.
VRE fair value is that of the held investment, not 100% enterprise value. Other holdings have unavailable fair values per footnote; no automatic zero uplift.
Costs and provisions; do not use investment/charter capital as enterprise fair value.
Footnote confirms insufficient information to determine fair values for starred other investments.
Recognized provisions already in liabilities. Some supplier negotiations are ongoing, not a proven zero incremental exposure.
Commitments and partner-sharing rights need mapping to existing assets/liabilities and project forecasts before any additional deduction.
Separate categories, no aggregate unconditional debt total. Subsequent land notification not automatically a FY2025 recognized liability or extra cost outside forecasts.
Undiscounted future rent is not PV. Guarantee/security and interest-support amounts not quantified; do not assume zero or mechanically deduct after cash-flow rents.
Unidentified subsidiary funding right cannot be allocated to all projects. Unknown additional exposures stay visible.
Management rounded summary cross-checks audited debt; percentages do not replace instrument schedules.
Vinhomes management sub-scope within VIC report; aggregate unbilled sales are not project net cash, not recognized revenue or guaranteed collectible cash.
Page 77 uses doanh thu including BCC for 183.1t; keep caption/scope variant visible, do not resolve by amount equality.
Issuer board approval of project scale/investment; not RNAV, residual cost, guaranteed return or evidence of full ownership.
